title: the librarian owns the cross-domain question corpus
intention: The librarian owns the cross-domain question corpus: a git JSON file beside its code, every question marked verbatim or proposed, planted as a keyed question tree with its known sequences linked followed-by.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: the cross-domain questions live in CodeMother (cairn/devices/codemother/cognition_questions.json, embedded by seed_trees.py) with 13 of UU's 18 verbatim Q-cog questions (014..018 lost in the move) and 11 Gemini-worded questions labelled Akien verbatim. Akien 2026-11-05 (open-6f41eecaf09d): 'if a device owns a question, it's also kind of a delegate, because all knowledge belongs ultimately to the librarian' and 'we can include all the questions. i expect i have a couple of hundred in my own head.' and 'right, these are cross-domain-questions. a special kind.' Outline 4.3.1.11.
traces_to: Outline 4.3.1.11 (Akien 2026-11-05). Telos: work the way Akien does. Law 1. Law 5.
how: New cairn/devices/librarian/cross_domain_questions.json: {what, why, questions: [{id, question, function, origin: 'verbatim'|'proposed', said_by, date, source}], sequences: [{name, source, order: [ids]}]}. Seed: UU's 18 Q-cog-001..018 verbatim (text exactly as in ~/dev/src/UnseenUniversity/devlab/runtime/memory/questions/*Q-cog-0NN*.json, said_by Akien, date and source from each file's body.source); Akien's 3 Novelty.txt questions Q-nov-001..003 verbatim (source ~/TheIgorsProject/Akien/DATED/20260714.Novelty.txt:169, date 2026-07-14); the 11 six-angle questions Q-nov-004..014 as proposed, said_by Gemini (GeiniOnNovelty.md 2026-07-23). Two sequences: novelty = [Q-cog-013, Q-nov-001, Q-cog-006, Q-nov-002, Q-nov-003] (Novelty.txt 2026-07-14); cortical_columns = [Q-cog-010, Q-cog-011, Q-cog-012, Q-cog-013] (2026-07-02). New cairn/devices/librarian/cross_domain_questions.py: load(path=None) validates and returns the corpus, raising CorpusRefused naming every lack in one pass (duplicate id, origin not verbatim/proposed, verbatim entry without date or source, sequence id that resolves to no question); plant(*, table='librarian_cross_domain_questions', conn=None) calls trees.ensure_trees(table, owner='librarian', keyed=True) and trees.deposit_keyed(question text, key=id, provenance={source: 'cross_domain_questions.json#'+id, origin, said_by}, meta={function, origin}) per question (no embedding: the questions are found by key; their answers are what get embedded, outline 4.3.1.11.2), then trees.link(earlier node, later node, 1.0) for each consecutive pair of each sequence, the earlier as source_id; idempotent; returns {planted, links}. CLI: python3 -m cairn.devices.librarian.cross_domain_questions plant. Depends on ticket e62f40f35f59 (keyed tree: ensure_trees keyed=True, deposit_keyed, find). The librarian charter's public_interface gains the module.
falsifier: (1) load() returns the corpus and every entry's origin is verbatim or proposed, every verbatim entry carries said_by, date and source; (2) all 18 UU Q-cog texts are present verbatim, character for character as the proof's literal copy of the UU corpus; (3) Q-nov-001..003 are verbatim with source naming 20260714.Novelty.txt; Q-nov-004..014 are proposed with said_by Gemini; (4) load() over a corpus with a duplicate id, a missing origin, a verbatim entry without source, and a sequence naming an unknown id raises CorpusRefused naming all four in one pass; (5) plant into a scratch keyed table lands one leaf per question, find(id) returns that question's text, and no cairn_embeddings row is written for any question node; (6) plant twice leaves the leaf and link counts unchanged; (7) after plant, each consecutive pair of each sequence has a cairn_links row whose source_id is the earlier question's node and target_id the later's; (8) the librarian charter's public_interface names cairn.devices.librarian.cross_domain_questions.

out: the harvest pass and the add command (their own ticket)

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs, and the how carries: the corpus file's exact shape, where every seed text comes from (UU file paths, Novelty.txt line), which are proposed, the two sequences in order, load's refusals, plant's calls into the trees tool with their arguments, the link direction, and the proof path with one tooth per clause. It needs e62f40f35f59 built first, which the how names.
